description: This file is a shell script that contains a series of test cases aimed at verifying the behavior of Git merge operations, particularly focusing on directory/file conflicts, merge conflicts resolution, and path ordering. It sets up Git repositories, performs various commits and merges, and checks for expected outcomes, error conditions, and file states.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case that expects a command sequence to succeed.

methods.name: test_expect_code
methods.description: Checks that a command exits with a specific code.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Asserts that a command must fail.

methods.name: test_stdout_line_count
methods.description: Verifies the number of lines output to stdout from a command.

methods.name: test_path_is_file
methods.description: Checks if a specified path is a file.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares expected and actual output or files.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test script execution.
